resources.string: When a new version of the uwuPromptr app is out
Version %1$s of the uwuPromptr app is out. You have %2$s.
To update itself, uwuPromptr needs permission to install apps. Turn on Allow from this source, then come back.
Could not reach the update server. Check your connection and try again.
The download did not finish. Check your connection and try again.
The download did not match the release on GitHub, so it was not installed. Try again later.
That file is not newer than the version you have, so it was not installed.
This copy of uwuPromptr was installed from somewhere else and cannot be updated in place. Uninstall it, then install the app from GitHub.
There is not enough room on this phone to install the update. Free up some space and try again.
The update was not installed. Try again, or download it from GitHub.
